build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run pyodide && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; worker-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost blob: data:

bundle.longDescription: MathVerse turns mathematics into something you can touch: surfaces, vector fields, transformations, differential equations, PDEs and curved geometry you can grab, rotate and experiment with, plus a homework companion and guided tutorials. Everything runs locally.
